{{Quote|Watch those wrist rockets!|A clone trooper|<ref name="SWBFII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>}}
'''Wrist rockets''' were rockets or projectiles that were fired from a [[wrist rocket launcher]].

==Description==
[[File:Wristrocket_egwt.png|thumb|left|180px|Wrist rocket launcher schematics]]
There were various types of wrist rockets that were fired from a wrist rocket launcher, such as "dumb rockets" (missiles with no tracking ability) and homing [[Missile/Legends|missiles]]. The homing missiles combined the computer systems of both wristband and rocket to lock onto movement.

Aside from these, there were many more exotic rockets that could be used, such as:

*[[Type-12A Anti-Personnel Rocket|Anti-personnel rockets]]<ref name="CWCG" />
*[[Type-12B Hollow-Tip Rocket|Stun rockets]]
*Flash rockets which used intense light to cause temporary blindness<ref name="CWCG" />
*Anti-vehicle rockets which were powerful enough to damage and disable vehicles<ref name="CWCG" />
*Ion blast rockets which used ion damage to affect droids and cybernetic systems<ref name="CWCG" />
*Hollow-tip rockets which injected the target with a [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve toxin]] or exploded with [[stun gas]].<ref name="CWCG" />

Many rockets had a maximum range of twenty-five meters, while a few could reach seventy-five meters.

==History==
The technology of wrist rockets and their launchers was in use since at least [[3951 BBY|four thousand years]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The bounty-hunter [[Mira]] was particularly skilled with them. Direct-fire wrist rockets were also utilized by [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]]. The [[Kelvarek Consolidated Arms/Legends|Kelvarek Consolidated Arms]] [[MM9 mini concussion rocket launcher/Legends|MM9 rocket system]] system was used by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], and his father, [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].
